scope: Locally reviewed, opt-in first-setup evidence only
sourceOfCounts: No participant reports or moderated sessions have been recorded in this local scorecard. Public/unreviewed reports are not counted automatically.
reviewRules: Count failed attempts and unobserved follow-ups; do not silently drop them.
Separate published npm, supplied preview and local-checkout builds and starting states.
Exclude reports without aggregate consent from aggregate counts.
Treat self-reported outcomes separately from validated live compatibility and consented public adoption.
Store only bounded aggregate metadata; no customer identities, source, URLs or credentials.
